emitterShape.description: Spatial rule used to create particles inside the selected region.

emitterInnerRadius.description: Empty inner radius of a ring or radial emitter, relative to the shorter image side.

emitterOuterRadius.description: Outer radius of a ring or radial emitter, relative to the shorter image side.

size.description: Base particle size relative to the shorter image side.

sizeVariation.description: Random per-particle variation around the base size.

sizeAtBirth.description: Multiplier applied to particle size at the beginning of its lifetime.

sizeAtDeath.description: Multiplier applied to particle size at the end of its lifetime.

speed.description: Base particle travel speed across the selected region.

speedVariation.description: Random per-particle variation around the base speed.

motionMode.description: Linear motion follows angle and forces; orbit motion revolves around the emitter.

orbitCycles.description: Signed number of revolutions made during one particle lifetime.

angle.description: Direction or orientation in degrees. Drag the angle handle on the image when available.

spread.description: Angular emission cone in degrees around the main direction.

gravity.description: Constant vertical acceleration; negative values rise and positive values fall.

drag.description: Resistance that progressively reduces particle velocity over its lifetime.

oscillation.description: Side-to-side displacement perpendicular to the main particle direction.

oscillationCycles.description: Whole side-to-side oscillations during one particle lifetime.

attraction.description: Signed acceleration toward the emitter center; negative values repel.

turbulence.description: Strength of deterministic irregular motion applied over particle lifetime.

turbulenceScale.description: Spatial frequency of the deterministic turbulence field.

depthPerspective.description: Perspective expansion applied while depth-emitted particles travel toward the viewer.

trailLength.description: Fraction of particle lifetime represented by its trailing streak.

trailSamples.description: Segments used to draw each particle trail; higher values cost more to render.

rotationCycles.description: Signed sprite revolutions during one particle lifetime.

rotationVariation.description: Per-particle variation applied to rotational speed.

opacity.description: Maximum opacity applied after sprite alpha and lifetime fades.

colorChangeStart.description: Lifetime point at which interpolation toward the target color begins.

colorChangeEnd.description: Lifetime point at which the target color is fully reached.

brightnessVariation.description: Random per-particle brightness difference around the atlas color.

atlasColumns.description: Number of equal columns in the sprite atlas.

atlasRows.description: Number of equal rows in the sprite atlas.

atlasMode.description: Random frame gives each particle a stable variant; animated advances through cells over life; emitter angle maps direction to a cell.

blendMode.description: Normal preserves sprite alpha; additive emits light by adding sprite color to the image.

fadeIn.description: Fraction of particle lifetime used to fade from transparent to visible.

fadeOut.description: Point in normalized particle lifetime at which fading to transparent begins.
